form.title: Register your live account
form.subtitle: Complete the form below. After you register, you will be taken to the client portal to sign in.
form.emailPlaceholder: Please input real email to receive application result
form.passwordHint: At least 8 characters with letters and numbers
form.confirmIntro: By creating an account I confirm:
form.confirm1Start: (1) You confirm that you are 18 years of age or older and agree to our
form.confirm2: (2) I agree that GTCFX may contact me within a reasonable time;
form.confirm3: (3) My phone number is not on the Do Not Call Register (DNCR). I declare that I am not a Politically Exposed Person (PEP), nor have I ever held any significant public office. I also confirm that I have never been convicted of any offense related to money laundering, fraud, bribery, corruption, or any other criminal offense, and that I am not currently subject to any ongoing regulatory or legal proceedings.

errors.firstNameLetters: First name can only contain letters

sidebar.needHelpText: Questions about your application? Our support team is ready to help.

success.title: Thank you for [registering]!
success.lead: Your application has been received successfully.
success.leadNamed: Thank you, {name} — your application has been received successfully.
success.emailTip: We sent your login details and the next steps to the email above. If it is not there within a few minutes, please check your spam or promotions folder.
success.redirecting: Taking you to the client portal…

steps.title: Open your welcome email
steps.text: You will find your client portal login URL, email, and password so you can sign in securely.

steps.title: Log in to the client portal
steps.text: Use the details in the email to access your account and begin onboarding.

steps.title: Complete your profile
steps.text: Fill in your personal, address, and financial information as requested.

steps.title: Upload your documents
steps.text: Submit a valid ID and proof of address (dated within the last 3 months).

steps.title: Account verification
steps.text: Our team reviews your documents and confirms your account by email, usually within 1–2 business days.

success.footerNote: Keep your login details safe and do not share your password with anyone.
